One church. Three languages.

認識慕道園華人浸信會

A church family in Alhambra, growing together in Cantonese, English and Mandarin.

我們在阿罕布拉市，以粵語、英語及國語一同敬拜、成長。

Our story · 教會介紹 Our beliefs · 信仰告白

Our mission

使命宣言

Knowing God is our foundation, glorifying God is our goal. Through worship, fellowship, discipleship, ministry, and evangelism, we seek to know God, and make His name known.

認識神為基礎，榮耀神是目標。我們藉著敬拜﹑團契﹑門徒訓練﹑事奉﹑傳福音來認識和榮耀神。

Our story

教會介紹

Our church was founded in 1977 with worship in Cantonese. During the 1980s, as the number of Mandarin-speaking immigrants in Los Angeles grew rapidly, the church saw the need to share the gospel and provide a spiritual home for new arrivals. Mandarin worship began in 1988. English worship was added in 1991, and the church continues to worship in all three languages.

教會成立於 1977年。教會剛開始是使用粵語崇拜。但從八十年代起，教會看到講國語的新移民人數在洛杉磯迅速增長，考慮到新移民對基督福音的需要。於是，教會決定開展國語事工，為新移民群體預備一個屬靈的家，於1988年開始了國語崇拜。之後，在1991年教會又增設了英語的崇拜，直到如今，教會一直保持有三種語言的崇拜。

1977

The church begins with Cantonese worship.

教會成立，開始粵語崇拜。

1988 → 1991

Mandarin worship begins in 1988, followed by English worship in 1991.

1988年開始國語崇拜，1991年增設英語崇拜。

Our pastoral team

教牧團隊

Rev. Caleb Cheung, Ph.D.

張健庭博士

Senior Pastor and Cantonese Congregation Pastor

主任牧師及粵語堂牧師

Pastor Caleb is from Hong Kong. After being called to ministry, he studied theology at Fuller Theological Seminary and pursued doctoral studies in theology and philosophy of religion at Claremont Graduate University. He has continued serving and shepherding this church and is its senior pastor.

張健庭牧師來自香港，多年前蒙召在福樂神學院(Fuller Theological Seminary)念神學，繼在克箂蒙研究大學(Claremont Graduate University) 進修博士課程專修神學及宗教哲學，後留在本教會事奉與牧養，現任本教會主任牧師。

Contact Pastor Caleb · 聯絡牧師

Rooted in faith

我們的信仰

Read our statement of faith and its scripture references.

閱讀我們的信仰告白及相關經文。

What we believe · 我們的信仰告白
